name: profile-settings-02
title: Personal details settings
description: A full settings screen inside an app: a sidebar with folding groups, a workspace switcher and usage, settings tabs, and a personal details card with a country-code phone field.

useCases: Settings pages for SaaS and AI apps
Workspace apps with a sidebar and team plans
Account pages with contact and phone details

a11y.reducedMotion: Nothing slides, grows or shakes: sidebar groups and the sidebar itself fold at once, the country list and menus only fade, the footer doesn't shake, and the spinner holds still.

keyboard.action: Moves through the workspace menu, the sidebar, the top bar, the settings tabs, each field, then Cancel and Update profile
Folds or opens a sidebar group, opens the workspace, account or country menu, or stars a run
Moves through the country list and menus; typing in the country list filters it
Saves the profile while there are unsaved changes
Closes an open menu, list or the phone sidebar

notes: Every field has a visible label; errors sit under their field, linked with `aria-describedby`, and say how to fix it.
The footer message (“1 unsaved change”, “Save or cancel your changes first”, “Changes saved”) is a polite live region.
Sidebar group headings are buttons with `aria-expanded`; the current sidebar link and tab have `aria-current="page"`; a folded sidebar is inert.
Icon-only buttons are named for what they do: “Hide sidebar”, “Notifications, 3 unread”, “Star Lead scoring pipeline”, “Country code: India (+91)”.
Leaving with unsaved changes (a tab or sidebar link) keeps you on the page and says why; closing the tab asks the browser to confirm.
gaps: Flags in the country list are emoji; on systems without flag emoji they show as two-letter codes, which screen readers read letter by letter (the country name follows). (WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content)
